## 🐛 Fixed
- golang.org/x/net 0.62.0, with the fix for a denial of service in its HTML parser. TollRoll never parses HTML, so it was out of reach.
- The fortress kit is at 1.0.1. An app holding the phrase could announce an address that sent TollRoll's direct call to another page of a host on your network. The call now always goes where it belongs.
